project_type: Next.js 15 app (App Router) + Supabase Postgres + MCP server at /api/mcp. One user, no service-role key anywhere.
build_system: Bun — no npm scripts wrapper needed. `bun run typecheck` = `next typegen && tsc --noEmit`. No `bun install` needed (node_modules already present).
test_framework: bun test (Jest-compatible). DB tests: supabase test db (pgTAP, local only). `bun run db:reset --local` resets the local Supabase instance.
verification_instructions: 1. After any migration: `cd /home/kingsleydaprime/code/personal/mypaddie && bun run db:reset --local` (resets and replays all migrations). 2. Regenerate types: `bun run db:types` (requires local Supabase running after db:reset). 3. Full typecheck: `bun run typecheck`. 4. Unit tests: `bun test src`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/shared/supabase/database.types.ts — generated by `bun run db:types` after migrations. Must be regenerated whenever a migration changes enums, tables, or functions.
environment_constraints: Worktree is at /home/kingsleydaprime/code/personal/mypaddie. Never use relative paths — always the absolute path. Local Supabase runs on its default port (54322). Do not restart the dev server.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md only mentions reading `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for Next.js API changes. DECISIONS.md establishes: SECURITY INVOKER functions, set search_path = '', revoke from public/anon, grant to authenticated. DB invariants in DB (composite user_id FKs, append-only xp_log). XP always split by largest remainder. No `any` in TypeScript.
key_patterns: 1. DB functions: SECURITY INVOKER + set search_path = '' + revoke all from public, anon + grant execute to authenticated. 2. MCP tools: Zod inputSchema → repo function → ok(await withMode(db, now, result)) or toolError(msg). 3. New feature gets its own folder src/features/<name>/ with <name>.repo.ts and <name>.tools.ts. 4. Tools registered in src/app/api/mcp/route.ts via tools.area('Area', () => registerXTools(server)). 5. Enum changes: ALTER TYPE … ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS in a new migration. 6. Text-column status (like events.status): drop old check constraint, add new one including the new value.
directory_structure: src/features/<name>/ — one folder per feature (<name>.repo.ts, <name>.tools.ts, optionally <name>.ts for pure logic, <name>.test.ts). src/shared/ — config, domain vocab, Supabase client, MCP kit. supabase/migrations/ — named YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_<slug>.sql, all replayed in order on db:reset. src/app/api/mcp/route.ts — single file that imports and registers all tools.
